sources.title: Repository travel guide conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original multilingual travel and venue guide workflow distilled from maintained content projects

claims.statement: Current practical research, guide structure, itineraries by traveler need, source-language drafting before translation, CEFR readability, structured frontmatter, research dates, accessibility verification, and slug collision checks.

notes.title: Refresh Workflow
notes.text:
1. Review corrections and evaluations involving destination research, practical facts, accessibility, itineraries, translations, frontmatter, and filenames.
2. Update the smallest owning section.
3. Re-run trigger, routing, and output evaluations.
4. Update the review date after the guidance and evaluations agree.
